title: Separation of Abilities
description: This mod makes it so that each player only has one ability.
body:
Each player has a different ability!

When you join a server, everyone will be able to see their ability assignments. You can also see what abilities you currently have with the `/check_abilities` command.

| Ability        | 2 Players | 3 Players | 4 Players | 5 Players | 6 Players |
|----------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| Craft          | First     | First     | First     | First     | First     |
| Interact       | First     | First     | First     | Second    | Second    |
| Place Blocks   | First     | Second    | Second    | Third     | Third     |
| Destroy Blocks | Second    | Third     | Third     | Fourth    | Fourth    |
| Hurt Entities  | Second    | Third     | Fourth    | Fifth     | Fifth     |
| Use Items      | Second    | Second    | Second    | Second    | Sixth     |

A few notes:

- "Use Items" doesn't include food; everyone can eat. (However, only the "Use Items" person can drink potions or milk buckets.)
- Only the "Interact" person can set their spawn using a bed!
- "Hurt Entities" does _not_ include using a bow or crossbow; that is categorized as "Use Items".
- The order of the players is randomized and seed-dependent! This ensures that you will keep your same abilities on the same world (as long as the same number of people are connected), but can try out different abilities with different worlds.
- I would recommend 5 players for the best experience.
